events.title: [DEMO] `openai.ChatCompletion.create` removed from the Python SDK
events.summary: SIMULATED EVENT for the Tracewise demo, modelled on the openai-python 1.x migration. The module-level ChatCompletion interface is no longer available; use a client instance and client.chat.completions.create.

evidence.label: Simulated migration note
evidence.detail: openai.ChatCompletion.create no longer exists. Use OpenAI().chat.completions.create.

events.remediation: Instantiate `client = OpenAI()` and call `client.chat.completions.create(...)`. Upgrade the openai package to 1.x and adjust response handling (attribute access instead of dict access).

events.title: [DEMO] openai-python versions below 1.0.0 reach end of support
events.summary: SIMULATED EVENT for the Tracewise demo. Versions of the Python package older than 1.0.0 will no longer receive fixes.
events.remediation: Upgrade the `openai` dependency to a 1.x release and re-test. Pin the new version in requirements.txt.

events.title: [DEMO] `openai.completions.create` (legacy text completions) deprecated in the Node SDK
events.summary: SIMULATED EVENT for the Tracewise demo. The legacy completions method is deprecated; use chat completions or the responses API.
events.remediation: Move to client.chat.completions.create or the newer API recommended in the provider documentation.
